final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and checking if the level is ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format, extracted the service, level (uppercased), message, and the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). I also summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I accumulated counts by service for the repeat counts. Then I wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.
